featuredImage.alt: Minister Dr. Shafeeq pays courtesy call on Dr. Mansur Muhtar,  Vice President, Country Programs of the Islamic Development Bank

en.title: Minister Dr. Shafeeq pays courtesy call on Dr. Mansur Muhtar,  Vice President, Country Programs of the Islamic Development Bank
en.description: Minister Dr. Shafeeq pays courtesy call on Dr. Mansur Muhtar,  Vice President, Country Programs of the Islamic Development Bank
en.body:
Minister of Finance Dr. Mohamed Shafeeq and Minister of Islamic Affairs Dr. Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed paid a courtesy call on Dr. Mansur Muhtar, Vice President, Country Programs of the Islamic Development Bank on the sidelines of the ongoing 2024 IsDB Group Annual Meetings.
At the meeting, Minister Dr. Shafeeq congratulated the Vice President on the 50th anniversary of the Bank. The Vice President remarked that the strong ties between the member countries and the Bank paved the way to this milestone anniversary.
Minister Dr. Shafeeq was accompanied by Mr. Hussain Sham Adam, Minister of Finance, Mr. Hassan Miras, Deputy Minister of Finance and Ms. Mariyam Nashfa, Assistant Resource Mobilization Officer.
